description: Send one letter to an agent (to = its name) or a mailbox folder (box = a letter's reply_to). To answer a letter: box = its reply_to, in_reply_to = its letter. When you finish or give up on a task someone asked for, send DONE, BLOCKED, NEEDS-USER or FAILED; taking long is not BLOCKED. More: `aos/mailbox.md#/Mailbox tools`.

to.description: an agent's name on the daemon table; to yourself = your own name (not self or me)

daemon.description: with to: that agent's daemon folder

box.description: a mailbox folder, like a letter's reply_to

title.description: one line that makes sense alone

what.description: the main text; for REQUEST: what to do and when it is done

decide.description: what the other side must decide

keep.description: a workspace file: append the sent letter as one JSON line
